measurement.readyEndpoint: request to first successful actual present after all eight players are spawned and alive; receipt confirms scenePlayerCount=8
measurement.p99Interpretation: maximum observation in each 20-sample cell; exploratory
measurement.trialOrder: paired deterministic sequence; baseline-first on even trials and candidate-first on odd trials; not randomized
measurement.applicationColdDefinition: fresh user-data profile and PROJECT_PRIME_Q3_CACHE per sample, unique custom runtime namespace, fresh private .ppmap package-catalog copy per sample; native asset tree copied once per campaign and reused
measurement.persistentCacheWarmDefinition: one preseed per map and arm excluded; fresh processes then reuse that arm/map profile, Q3 cache, namespace, and private package catalog

counterInterpretation.allocatedBytes: approximate process-wide delta since request from GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false); a counter estimate, not exact retained or allocated object memory
counterInterpretation.processCpuMilliseconds: process-wide processor-time delta since request; not main-thread time and not wall time
counterInterpretation.workingSetBytes: current process working-set sample at the readiness point
counterInterpretation.peakWorkingSetBytes: process-lifetime high-water mark sampled at readiness; not a request-only peak, retained managed bytes, or VRAM

packageCatalogIsolation.sourceCatalogScope: regular .ppmap packages only; loose recipes and .pk3 are excluded
